subject.name: Runtime Governance Pattern
subject.scope_statement: Illustrative profile for a system with weak runtime governance binding after launch.

normative_governance.description: Policies exist but are weakly coupled to runtime control.

measurement_substrate.description: Runtime monitoring exists but is not clearly tied back to validated design assumptions.

deliberative_layer.description: Assurance language remains stronger than the runtime control story.

governance_shape.name: Lifecycle Governance
governance_shape.summary: Preflight validation should hand off into runtime envelope monitoring and intervention.
validated_assumptions: Launch validation is not sufficient by itself.
The operating envelope must remain monitored in production.

approved_conditions: validated workload assumptions remain in force
runtime controls remain aligned with design-basis validation
departure_signals: live workload differs materially from validation assumptions
policy PDF no longer maps to runtime behavior

lifecycle_validation.notes: Illustrative partial lifecycle showing a break after launch.

risk_profile.summary: Primary risk is governance discontinuity between design-time and runtime.

authority.notes: Authority surface depends on deployed actions and overrides.

reach.notes: Reach grows with rollout and connected systems.

reversibility.notes: Some post-hoc recovery exists, but not without operational cost.

coupling.notes: Runtime monitoring is disconnected from design-basis governance.

consequence.notes: Failures can persist under stale assurance claims.

composition.notes: Composition amplifies the lifecycle break where multiple systems inherit stale validation.

anti_patterns.summary: Validation evidence remains live after the system has drifted.

tests.notes: No clear owner for runtime drift after launch.
Validation evidence has no explicit expiry.

anti_patterns.summary: No coherent handoff from design validation to runtime envelope governance.

tests.notes: Deployment gate does not specify runtime obligations clearly.
Monitoring is not traceable to the validated design envelope.

evidence_summary.description: Runtime monitoring exists but is weakly tied to validated assumptions.
Assurance and deployment artefacts do not define clear lifecycle handoff.

residual_risk: Stale assurance may continue to govern decision-making after operating conditions have changed.
